text_block_list.text: On the way to the trainer's office.

Objective accomplished. Our deal ends 
here, Sirius—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
So? Have you properly prepared that thing 
we talked about?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Wondered who it was, just a little 
puppy.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
What am I doing, you ask? Why, I'm making 
a shady deal, of course—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Idiot, it's just a weigh-in sheet. Don't 
drag me into your troublesome crap."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What's critical for losing weight without 
losing muscle is planning and diet.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
So we provided the evidence and the plan. 
This is just confirming the results.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
My lazy style is the result of my own 
choices. However, the sooner negative 
debts are settled, the better. It's a 
matter of efficiency.

They're two of the sharpest theorists at 
the academy. You couldn't ask for better 
partners to help with weight management.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...? Did you really think we would 
assist a rival without expecting anything 
in return?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Once your weight loss succeeds, you'll 
work for us for a whole day. Those are our 
terms for helping you.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: That's how it is. Go on, pup.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I will train in the meantime. Efficient, 
is it not?

And so, I was roped into a full day of 
hard labor...
